title: Stone structures
content:
# Stone structures

# Introduction

Stone structures become available after the acquisition of iron and subsequently a stonecutter. They require stone and the proximity of a stonecutter to be built and repaired.
Stone fortifications are stronger than those from wood, which can make them more resistant against raids.

## Common properties

Stone structures share the following properties:

• Property: Durability | Value: 1500

• Property: Support | Value: Stone (from 100 to 1000)

• Property: Loss | Value: 1/8 vertical, 1/1 horizontal

• Property: Resistances | Value: Weak: Pickaxe Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pierce, Chop, Lightning Resistant: Fire, Frost Immune: Poison, Spirit

• Property: Damaged by rain | Value: No

### Floors and stairs

• Structure: Stone floor 2x2 | Materials: Stone x6 | Size: 2x2x1

• Structure: Stone stair | Materials: Stone x8 | Size: 2x2x1

### Walls

• Structure: Stone wall 1x1 | Materials: Stone x3 | Size: 1x1x1

• Structure: Stone wall 2x1 | Materials: Stone x4 | Size: 2x1x1

• Structure: Stone wall 4x2 | Materials: Stone x6 | Size: 4x2x1

### Supports

• Structure: Stone pillar | Materials: Stone x5 | Size: 1x1x2

• Structure: Stone arch | Materials: Stone x4 | Size: 2x1x1
